 Lance Bass Reveals What His 5-Year-Old Twins Really Think of ‘NSync’s Christmas Album (Exclusive)
 By Mike Vulpo 
 November 17, 2026 
 TOP STORIES 
 Share on
 Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook 
 Share on X
 (Opens in new window) X 
 Lance Bass Rodin Eckenroth/Getty Images for Caruso 
 Tap Here To Add Us Magazine As A Trusted Source
 Lance Bass ’ family can’t celebrate the holiday season without the sweet sounds of ‘NSync ‘s Christmas album.
 “[My twins] love their Christmas music. They love the ‘NSync Christmas album, which is my favorite ‘NSync album,” Bass, 47, exclusively shared with Us at the 25th annual Christmas at The Grove tree-lighting celebration in Los Angeles on Monday, November 16. “They’re finally understanding what Dad does. They always are like, ‘Yeah, I see my dad on TV,’ but I’m like, ‘I sang before that.’ Now they are figuring out their dad actually sang.”
 Last month, Bass and his husband, Michael Turchin , celebrated their twins Alexander and Violet’s 5th birthday with a “ Jurassic Sparkle World ”-themed party.
 These days, the family unit is focused on getting in the holiday spirit with a whole lot of Christmas decor.
 Related: Lance Bass Addresses Rumors He’s ‘Filthy Rich’ From ’NSync Earnings 
 Lance Bass is peeling back the financial curtain on his days in ‘NSync. “We had a per diem: $35 per day,” Bass, 47, claimed on the Thursday, October 8, episode of The Zach Sang Show. “Our first check was $10,000 … after years of No. 1 albums, sellout tours. Man, I don’t know how many […] 
 “I think 5 is when they start understanding everything, so I’m excited to see all the magic in their eyes,” Bass told Us . “My kids definitely caught the decorating bug this year. They want to go very big. They love Halloween, but Christmas is another level. All day long, we are decorating and savoring each day.”
 The singer — who released Home for Christmas with ‘NSync in 1998 — is hoping to spread some holiday cheer to fans in his own unique way by releasing a brand-new children’s book.
 View this post on Instagram 
 Titled The Legend of Mrs Claws , the family-friendly read tells the story of a small cat named Mrs. Claws. On Scary Street, she does her best to scare and fright — but nothing ever seems right. Everything changes on one cold night when she stows away in Santa’s sleigh.
 “To have a children’s book out during the holidays is the most special thing,” Bass shared with Us . “I just had a signing here at The Grove, and to see all of these kids who just know me as an author, I love it. To see them light up because of my words is amazing.”

 On Monday night, Bass had the honor of hosting The Grove’s annual Christmas tree lighting.
 Meghan Trainor , Nicole Scherzinger , Mark Ambor , Jamie Miller ,  Antonio Cipriano , JYT and Jason Mraz were just some of the performers who helped usher in the holiday season. Guests were also treated to Santa Claus’ arrival, a snowfall, drone and fireworks spectacular and the lighting of the 100-foot Christmas tree.
 “It’s been magical for me,” Bass shared about the holiday season. “No one rings in the holiday season better than The Grove.”
